subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this issue remain the broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay umbrella, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that the recovery-carrier fixes landed?
rationale: The recovery code is largely on main, but the remaining fix changes Anthropic replay policy and has multiple overlapping PR attempts, so automation should not choose the permanent provider contract by itself.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded only after posting a clear handoff to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 and the active prevention PR.

options.title: Recovery-Only Closure
options.body: Treat the merged recovery slices as sufficient and defer prevention policy to later provider replay review, accepting continued exposure for thinking-enabled Anthropic histories.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers explicitly split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion around the landed recovery split and appears in current carrier history for the affected files.
